judge.name: GPT-6 Luna
judge.reviewer: GPT-6 Luna (automated model judge; not human)

interpretation: Retrieval configuration and corpus hash were held constant; only the judgment pool changed.
B3 and B4 gained newly judged positive top-10 candidates, so their P@10 changes are evaluation-label effects, not ranking-algorithm improvements.

B2 remains weak: P@10 is unchanged and nDCG@10 changes only slightly. Its legacy DEV-v1 Judged@10=0.75 counted five empty graph results as zero coverage; pair-based coverage treats empty rankings as vacuously complete. B2 had genuine missing qrels in top-20 and those pairs are now judged.

DEV-v1 Recall denominators covered its original qrels; DEV-v1.1 uses the expanded exact B0–B4 top-20 union. Recall deltas therefore reflect the changed judgment pool and must not be read as ranking gains or losses.
